name: Into the Pit
oracle_text:
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
You may cast spells from the top of your library by sacrificing a nonland permanent in addition to paying their other costs.
blocked_sentences: You may cast spells from the top of your library by sacrificing a nonland permanent in addition to paying their other costs.

needs.what: a `cast_from_library_top` static that carries an additional cost imposed on every spell cast through it -- here a `sacrifice` cost of one nonland permanent ({"sacrifice": {"not_types": ["Land"]}}) paid on top of the spell's own mana and additional costs (601.2b/601.2h), with no affects_spells filter and no pay_life_instead
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cast_from_library_top` carries only `pay_life_instead` (Bolas's Citadel's alternative price), `affects_spells` and `cast_gains_keywords`; the loader compiles `cost` onto a static only for `spell_cost_increase` and `granted_alternative_cost`, and refuses a filterless, unpriced `cast_from_library_top`. Nothing lets the permission demand a sacrifice as an additional cost, and writing it without the price would be every spell castable off the top for free extra -- a much stronger card
